in_sanskrit.name: दृष्टि
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: the faculty of seeing and observing; the power of perceiving through the eyes; the act or instance of seeing or observing

in_marathi.name: Dristi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Vision, Perception, Insight
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dristi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dristi refers to the act of seeing or observing. In Hindu mythology, it is considered a divine gift of inner vision and wisdom. The Goddess of Vision and Perception is called 'Drishti Devi'.
